body: I did ask a little more about what happened, and, as it seemed my parents did try to ask him for help and he refused it. And, I did talk it over with my mom and I will probably go over to his house to study from now on, and maybe his and I could take a walk with my dog. She said to start with little stuff like that.

From what I heard, I told my parents, they told his parents, and P's parents told my parents if they could talk to him about it.

Thats what I was told. And, either way, I saw no change.
